summary:
**Operational register:** Cool-toned, muted, geometric, precise, data-dense, light backgrounds. Clinical futurism with a weathered patina. (Archon dashboards, tooling, data artifacts.)
**Contemplative register:** Warm-dominant, high-contrast, organic, gestural, atmosphere-forward, dark backgrounds. Sublime cosmic expressionism. (Worldbuilding, creative work, mood pieces.)
**Shared core:** Serious emotional register, intentional authored aesthetics (never generic), information density (even "sparse" compositions are chromatically dense), and a preference for work that rewards sustained attention.
activeTendencies: **Serious emotional register** (Emotional: 0.25, confidence: 0.35) — strongest signal. Awe-serious and data-serious are both valid. Never whimsical, never frivolous.
**Geometric precision** (Geometry: 0.28, Precision: 0.22, confidence: 0.30) — lean toward mechanical, but organic forms now explicitly in range for contemplative contexts
**Cool palette default** (Temperature: 0.38, confidence: 0.30) — cool for operational, warm accepted for sublime/cosmic
**Context-dependent contrast** (Contrast: 0.45, confidence: 0.30) — muted for operational, high-contrast for contemplative
**Sublime appetite** (Sublime Scale: 0.75, confidence: 0.30) — strong pull toward cosmic/vast/numinous imagery
**Bimodal light/dark** (Light/Dark: 0.35, confidence: 0.30) — light for tools, dark for atmosphere

dimensions.name: Density
dimensions.measures: How much visual information occupies the canvas. Few elements with generous whitespace vs. many elements creating texture and complexity.
dimensions.evidence: Archon dashboard — dense data presentation with gauges, tables, sector heat maps, yield curves, SVG charts. Accepted and praised without density complaints. Cosmic flame artwork — sparse void with concentrated energy mass. User absorbed this as valid alongside dense dashboard layouts. Suggests bimodal density preference: rich for operational, sparse-concentrated for contemplative.

dimensions.name: Symmetry
dimensions.measures: Whether compositions favor equilibrium or deliberate imbalance. Centered, mirrored arrangements vs. off-axis, tension-creating layouts.
dimensions.evidence: Grid-based dashboard layout with symmetric gauge row and balanced card columns. Slightly structured/ordered preference.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.measures: Use of visual depth cues — shadows, overlapping planes, parallax, blur, z-axis layering vs. single-plane, flat design.
dimensions.evidence: Subtle panel layering, CRT vignette overlay, gauge ring depth, but not heavy shadow/parallax. Moderate depth. Cosmic flame artwork — extreme atmospheric depth via color layering, luminous bloom effects, and figure-ground scale differential. Deeper than dashboard work.

dimensions.name: Temperature
dimensions.measures: Dominant color temperature across outputs. Blues/greens/violets vs. reds/oranges/ambers/earth tones.
dimensions.evidence: Light mode palette is blue-gray backgrounds (#e8ecf2), deep teal accents (#1a7070). Cool-dominant with warm accent pops (amber, red used for data signaling only). Cosmic flame artwork — warm-dominant (red/orange/magenta core) accepted for sublime/cosmic contexts. Cool remains default for operational work. Bimodal.

dimensions.name: Chromatic Range
dimensions.measures: How many distinct hues appear in a typical output. Single-hue with value variation vs. full-spectrum color use.
dimensions.evidence: Multi-hue but restrained — teal, amber, magenta, red, green all present but muted and purposeful (each color signals different data categories). Cosmic flame artwork — full spectrum within the flame form (red through orange through magenta through blue-violet). More polychromatic than dashboard palette but still purposeful, not chaotic.

dimensions.name: Contrast
dimensions.measures: Value contrast and saturation levels. Soft, close-valued palettes vs. dramatic light/dark and vivid saturation.
dimensions.evidence: "Faded neon" was the explicit brief. Light mode uses muted, desaturated accent colors against soft backgrounds. User praised this. Not washed out, but deliberately restrained. Cosmic flame artwork — maximum contrast (pure white silhouette against pure black void, saturated flame mass). Accepted as valid alongside muted/faded neon. Context-dependent: high contrast for sublime, muted for operational.

dimensions.name: Geometry
dimensions.measures: Shape language. Hard edges, straight lines, circles/rectangles vs. freeform curves, natural forms, irregular boundaries.
dimensions.evidence: Dashboard uses grid layout, rectangular cards, circular gauge rings, straight-line charts, bar charts. Strongly geometric vocabulary. Cosmic flame artwork — entirely organic: gestural flame strokes, flowing energy forms, no straight lines. Absorbed as counterweight to geometric default. Organic forms now part of vocabulary for contemplative/creative contexts.

dimensions.name: Precision
dimensions.measures: Finish quality. Pixel-perfect, machine-made feel vs. visible hand, intentional imperfection, textures that suggest physical media.
dimensions.evidence: Monospace typography (Share Tech Mono, Orbitron), pixel-precise alignment, consistent spacing tokens, data-table precision. Very mechanical. Cosmic flame artwork — maximally expressive. Visible brushstrokes, irregular edges, hand-directed energy. Accepted alongside mechanical precision. Suggests bimodal: mechanical for tools, expressive for creative/worldbuilding.

dimensions.name: Motion Feel
dimensions.measures: Presence and intensity of animation and motion. Still compositions vs. persistent movement, particles, transitions, animated state.
dimensions.evidence: Subtle animation — header line pulse, CSS digital rain, logo flicker. Present but understated. User praised the overall design including these subtle motions. Cosmic flame artwork — implied kinetic energy through directional brushwork and flame dynamics. Static image but reads as frozen motion. Suggests appetite for more dynamic motion than dashboard's subtle pulses.

dimensions.name: Temporal Register
dimensions.measures: The era the aesthetic evokes. Vintage palettes, established patterns, nostalgia vs. bleeding-edge techniques, speculative forms, unfamiliar materiality.
dimensions.evidence: User explicitly requested "cyberpunk but lived in. Vintage feel." CRT scanlines + Orbitron font = retro-futuristic blend. Not purely retro, not purely futuristic — a synthesis. Cosmic flame artwork — timeless rather than era-specific. Neither retro nor futuristic — mythic. Consistent with retro-futuristic blend but adds a "timeless/mythic" register.

dimensions.name: Emotional Register
dimensions.measures: The emotional tone conveyed by visual choices. Formal, restrained, dignified vs. lighthearted, surprising, delightful.
dimensions.evidence: Investment intelligence dashboard — serious data presentation with atmospheric styling. Not austere (has personality), but firmly on the serious side. Cosmic flame artwork — serious/sublime. Reinforces the serious pole with a new shade: not austere, not data-serious, but *awe*-serious. Strongest confirmation of this dimension.

dimensions.name: Information Stance
dimensions.measures: Priority balance between conveying information and creating a feeling. Clarity and legibility first vs. mood and immersion first.
dimensions.evidence: Dashboard is data-first (14 API feeds, tables, charts, metrics) but wrapped in strong atmospheric cyberpunk theming. Data leads, atmosphere supports. Cosmic flame artwork — fully atmosphere-forward. No data, pure mood. Accepted alongside data-forward dashboard. Bimodal: data-first for operational, atmosphere-first for creative.

dimensions.name: Light Character
dimensions.measures: Quality and direction of light in an image. Soft ambient diffusion (overcast, shade, fill light, blue hour glow) vs. harsh directional light with strong shadows (noon sun, rim/backlight, spotlight, hard flash). Dimensional landmarks: golden hour (0.65 — moderately directional, warm), blue hour (0.30 — soft, cool), harsh noon (0.90 — hard overhead), rim/backlight (0.80 — dramatic directional), studio key light (0.70), available light (variable, 0.40-0.60).
dimensions.evidence: No data points yet. Awaiting first inspiration analysis via Tengan.

dimensions.name: Substrate/Grain
dimensions.measures: Surface texture quality of the image. Pristine pixel-perfect digital rendering vs. visible grain, noise, analog artifacts, and film stock character. Dimensional landmarks: clean digital sensor (0.10), medium format film (0.45 — fine grain, rich tonality), Portra 400 (0.55 — warm shift, moderate grain), Tri-X 400 (0.75 — bold contrast, strong grain), high ISO noise (0.70 — gritty digital), CRT/analog display texture (0.80), cross-processed (0.85 — shifted colors + heavy grain).
dimensions.evidence: No data points yet. However, existing profile shows affinity for CRT textures, "vintage feel", and "faded neon" — suggesting potential lean toward analog in contemplative contexts, with clean digital for operational. Awaiting first Tengan analysis.

dimensions.name: Atmosphere/Mood
dimensions.measures: Environmental atmospheric conditions and their contribution to image mood. Clean, well-lit, clear environments vs. suffused with haze, shadow, weather, and dramatic atmospheric phenomena. Dimensional landmarks: bright clear day (0.15), golden hour warmth (0.40), overcast diffusion (0.45), urban haze (0.55), fog/mist (0.75), rain with neon reflections (0.85), heavy shadow + smoke (0.90).
dimensions.evidence: No data points yet. Existing profile signals: "weathered", "lived in", cyberpunk theming suggest lean toward moody. But operational register prefers clarity. Bimodal potential. Awaiting first Tengan analysis.

dimensions.name: Light/Dark Preference
dimensions.measures: Preference for background luminance. Light, airy backgrounds vs. dark, immersive backgrounds.
dimensions.evidence: User was presented with both dark cyberpunk and light mode. Explicitly praised light mode: "i really love the light background design and theme and colors and everything." Cosmic flame artwork — deep black background. User absorbed this willingly. Light mode remains preferred for operational/dashboard contexts, but dark backgrounds are now valid for atmospheric/sublime work. Bimodal.

dimensions.name: Sublime Scale
dimensions.measures: Appetite for awe-scale imagery — vast cosmic spaces, overwhelming forces, the numinous. Whether compositions feel contained and personal or infinite and overwhelming.
dimensions.evidence: User engaged with cosmic flame artwork featuring a lone figure dwarfed by a massive energy form in a void. Immediately connected it to Cosmere, Cowboy Bebop gate sequences, and requested absorption. The sublime is a distinct aesthetic appetite.
